text: dsh-livevoice（DSH 插件，网页客户端）：为 DSH 加入 Codex 实时语音通话。它在会话页面提供 Live 按钮、语音控制条和设置入口，并由 DSH 主机代理连接 Codex 实时服务。用户可通过麦克风进行语音对话、查看转录并将任务交给当前 DSH 会话，还可静音、结束通话和查看任务回执。适合希望用语音和 Codex 交流并在同一 DSH 会话继续处理任务的用户。使用前需要 ChatGPT 或 Codex OAuth 登录，并允许浏览器使用麦克风。

dsh-livevoice adds Codex realtime voice to DSH web sessions. Start with Live or Ctrl+L, speak through the browser microphone, view transcripts, and delegate work to the current session. The dock supports mute and hangup. ChatGPT or Codex OAuth and microphone permission are required.
想通过麦克风和 Codex 实时对话
让 DSH 会话支持语音输入和语音回复
我想边说边把编程任务交给当前 DSH 会话
能不能在语音通话时看到识别出的转录内容
I want to talk to Codex in real time from my browser
Let me delegate coding work to the current DSH session by voice
我想用快捷键开始或结束实时语音通话
Can I see the live transcript and task status while speaking?
dsh-livevoice 的功能「实时语音通话」：在会话输入栏点击 Live 或按 Ctrl+L 建立浏览器 WebRTC 通话，使用可选语音并通过 DSH 主机完成信令。
dsh-livevoice 的功能「语音任务委派」：通话中的语音内容可作为任务交给当前 DSH 会话处理，并在语音界面显示任务回执。
dsh-livevoice 的功能「通话控制」：Live 控制条支持静音、结束或重试；快捷键 Ctrl+L 切换通话，Esc 结束，聚焦控制条时空格切换静音。
dsh-livevoice 的功能「OAuth 登录读取」：启动通话时从 DSH OAuth 登录存储、DSH 凭据存储或 Codex CLI 登录读取 Codex OAuth 凭据。
dsh-livevoice 使用 ChatGPT / Codex OAuth 凭据建立实时连接；普通 OpenAI 平台 API key 或 DeepSeek 默认登录不能替代此登录。
dsh-livevoice 的浏览器语音通话需要用户授予麦克风权限；网页端采集音频用于实时 WebRTC 通话。

dsh-livevoice README · Official DeepSeek Harness desktop app：Open **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin** and enter this in “Package name or address”:

```text
dsh-livevoice@npm:@aa2246740/dsh-livevoice@0.1.7
```

The desktop plugin manager owns the Desktop profile and bundled package manager. This release includes built `lib/`; normal use needs no clone, build, or DSHX installation. Follow the app if it asks you to reload or reopen after installation.

dsh-livevoice README · Web CLI：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-livevoice@npm:@aa2246740/dsh-livevoice@0.1.7
```

This official CLI command writes only the `web` profile; it cannot modify the Desktop App profile. For an already-running Web Host, reopen that Host once and reload the page because bundles are read at boot.

Codex realtime voice (`Ctrl+L` / `/live`) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-livevoice README · Web CLI：This is a protocol-complete port of omp’s GPT-Live path: ChatGPT OAuth, WebRTC media, Frameless Bidi sideband, client-side delegation into the current DSH session. It is not a local STT/TTS plugin.

dsh-livevoice README · Compatibility：The current source targets official DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.5** (`dsh-v0.2.1-rc.5`, SHA `b830ec950faba0a46dda564be3e2d854afed94f1`, npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.5`). Harness peers are `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.2.2`. That range accepts `0.2.1-rc.5`, rejects `0.2.1` alphas, and rejects the `0.2.0` series and `0.1.7-rc.2`.

dsh-livevoice README · Other install paths (development/local testing)：Local checkout or tarball:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/aa2246740/dsh-livevoice.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-livevoice
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-livevoice-0.1.7.tgz
```

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-livevoice
```

dsh-livevoice README · Auth: OAuth is required：Live voice **cannot** use a normal OpenAI platform API key or the default DeepSeek LLM login. Signaling posts to `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/realtime/calls` with a ChatGPT / Codex OAuth access token and a `Codex Desktop` originator.

The plugin does **not** depend on `dsh-oauth-login` being loaded. It reads credentials in this order:

dsh-livevoice README · Auth: OAuth is required：1. `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-oauth-auth.json` (`openai-codex`) — written by **dsh-oauth-login** / 订阅登录
2. DSH credential store `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` — official **Settings → models → ChatGPT Codex OAuth**
3. `~/.codex/auth.json` — official `codex login` (read-only fallback)

If none of those hold an OAuth grant, the Live button fails with `No Codex OAuth credential is available for a live call.`

dsh-livevoice README · Auth: OAuth is required：`dsh-oauth-login` is the usual way to get that grant inside DSH, but a user who already signed in through DSH’s built-in `openai-codex` OAuth flow is enough. A DeepSeek API key is not.

dsh-livevoice README · What is ported：| omp | DSH |
|---|---|
| `protocol.ts` Frameless Bidi | same types and codecs |
| Codex signaling + sideband | Host proxy (avoids browser CORS / WS headers) |
| Native WebRTC / Opus | Browser `RTCPeerConnection` + `getUserMedia` |
| `AgentSession.sendCustomMessage` | `agent.steer` while a turn is open; `agent.followup` when idle or running with no open turn |
| TUI visualizer | composer Live chip + live bar |
| `Ctrl+L` / `/live` | same |
| DeviceCheck attestation | not ported (omp also skips this off Apple silicon) |

dsh-livevoice README · What is ported：The voice model is `gpt-live-1-codex`. It only talks. Repository work is delegated into this DSH session.

Delegation preserves the user's current wording. A bounded recent transcript is attached separately so the worker can resolve references and sentence fragments without inheriting broader authorization: asking how a change could be done remains analysis, while an explicit request to do it authorizes execution. Read-only repository and session-status questions may be delegated.

dsh-livevoice README · Use：Composer **Live** button, or `Ctrl+L`, or `/live`. Esc ends the call. Space mutes while the live bar is focused.

“Ready — speak now” is shown only after WebRTC media/data-channel connection, an explicit Codex session-ready event, and a live microphone track. Until then the UI remains connecting and microphone transmission stays gated. A readiness timeout fails with a retry action; it never silently counts as connected. You can cancel while dialing.

dsh-livevoice README · Use：The Host maintains one live call across browser pages. Concurrent dials are serialized; a later dial replaces the earlier call. Failed dials do not block the queue, and shutdown waits for earlier dial attempts before clearing their calls.

dsh-livevoice README · Use：The live dock shows task receipts for the actual input and handoff sent to DSH. States come from dispatch, matching `agent/inbox/claimed`, `agent/inbox/discarded`, and the claimed turn's `turn/end` reason. “Worker replied” means only that a completed turn produced a response associated with the request; it is not verification of the work.

dsh-livevoice README · Use：Changing topics does not erase earlier answers. The bridge retains every non-tool response and associates it with requests consumed by the worker before that response. A later unclaimed request cannot receive an earlier answer; if several requests were consumed together, their answer is explicitly labeled shared, not independently fulfilled. Replies are returned at the end of their claimed turn even when another request is still queued for the next turn. Actual terminal states also go to the voice context, so it can report no reply, cancellation, failure, or stopped tracking instead of promising a nonexistent future result. There is no semantic topic classifier or extra worker process. This is an event-based approximation of answer ownership, not a guarantee of semantic correctness or 100% Codex behavior parity.

dsh-livevoice README · Use：Results and unsuccessful terminal outcomes use the explicit `speakable` context channel; routine progress and successful receipt metadata use `commentary`. These are the existing [Frameless Bidi channels](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/main/codex-rs/codex-api/src/endpoint/realtime_websocket/protocol.rs), not a new transport or a promise that speech generation is infallible.

dsh-livevoice README · Use：The server replays current-call receipts when the SSE connection reconnects and keeps all active receipts plus the 24 most recent settled receipts. The current page keeps its existing cards after hangup, when another call replaces the current call, and across a redial; replacement stops live tracking for the old call. Refreshing the page loses page-local history, and a newly opened page cannot retrieve receipts from an old replaced call because there is deliberately no new database. When a call ends while DSH work continues, its card freezes at “Call ended · follow in session” instead of pretending the work failed or completed.

dsh-livevoice README · Use：Voice names match Codex: arbor, breeze, cove, ember, juniper, maple, sol, spruce, vale.

HTTP/WS outbound honors `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-oauth-proxy.json` (same file as dsh-oauth-login) and `HTTPS_PROXY`. Browser audio uses WebRTC from the current device to OpenAI; being on this machine or the same LAN only means the control plane goes through DSH.

dsh-livevoice README · Rebuild committed lib/：Stock install uses the committed `lib/`. After TypeScript edits, rebuild with **pnpm**:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
pnpm build
```
dsh-livevoice README · macOS 麦克风恢复（0.1.4）：实时语音需要客户端签名包含 `com.apple.security.device.audio-input`。缺少该声明时，macOS 不会弹出授权窗口；插件会给出准确提示。权限被拒绝时，可直接打开麦克风设置，并执行不连接模型的麦克风检测。支持官方客户端和 DSH Studio 自用客户端。
dsh-livevoice README · 本地麦克风检测：在通用设置中点击“检测麦克风（不连接模型）”。检测只申请本机采集并立即释放音轨，不连接语音模型、不上传录音。官方 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 及 RC2 的 macOS 壳已包含 audio-input entitlement。
